lines: Apply for Affordable Housing Funds for projects throughout Marin.

To apply, complete and submit your Affordable Housing Fund application through the County of Marin’s Neighborly Participant Portal. Be sure to include all required attachments for your project type (rehabilitation, acquisition/new construction, or supplemental materials).
You may use the same application form to apply for Affordable Housing Fund (AHF) or Measure W funding. Please select the correct funding source when starting your application.
Need help? Download the Neighborly Affordable Housing Fund & Measure W Application Guide (PDF) for step-by-step instructions on creating an account, uploading files, and submitting your application.
Applicant and co-applicant organizational attachments (as applicable)
Financial statements for last three years (audited preferred)
Completed 1-year operating budget and 20-year cash flow
Documentation of site control (e.g. purchase contract, option to purchase, grant deed)
Memorandum of understanding between co-applicants or borrower and development consultant (if applicable)
Board Resolution that authorizes site acquisition and application for funds (if entity’s governing body is a board)
Appraisal (including Fair Market Value and Value with Regard to Restrictions)
Survey and Analysis of Building Systems
Copies of applications for other funding and commitment letters
Review our Affordable Housing Fund Guidelines page for more information.
You can use our project budget template for your Marin Affordable Housing Fund application.
We can also provide a pro forma template. To request a template, get in contact with us by email or phone (415) 473-7309, CA Relay 711.
Learn about how Housing Trust Funds are distributed and which projects and applicants are eligible.
